calls.title: Masterclass and Cary Rakin
calls.summary: The team is set to launch their MC Exec MBA-style learning program on July 7, targeting a small cohort with an AI-driven curriculum and a partnership with Chicago Booth. Early interest has been positive, prompting plans for larger, more expensive future cohorts. Concurrently, contract renewal discussions with Masterclass center around pricing increases and legal interpretations regarding notification periods. Masterclass raised concerns about a breach of contract due to late price change notifications. Growthbook countered that no breach occurred but offered pricing flexibility. Discussions also highlighted discrepancies in user counts impacting pricing terms, and both parties are seeking to finalize agreements before the July 31 deadline while maintaining a collaborative relationship.
calls.keywords: MC Exec, contract renewal, pricing negotiation, user seats, platform adoption, legal dispute
calls.action_items:
**Matt Elgie**
Review and respond to Growthbook’s formal proposal on renewal options (one-year at approximately $80K vs. two-year 70/100K) early next week (21:24)
Discuss internally with Masterclass legal and leadership team regarding contract extension feasibility and pricing (18:06)

**Cary Rakin**
Prepare and send a written summary of renewal options including one-year and two-year pricing structures to Masterclass (21:44)
Collaborate with Masterclass to enhance platform adoption and schedule potential training or lunch & learn sessions (24:34)

**Ryan McGurk**
Support price negotiation by proposing flexible offers such as $75K for one year or a two-year split of $65K and $100K to ease renewal friction (20:51)
Continue engagement with Masterclass on product capabilities and ensure alignment with their use cases via ongoing customer success interactions (23:35)
